name: handball-analyst
description: Software desktop di video editing/tagging per analisi partite di pallamano
author: Torecoach

scripts.ffmpeg:dev: rm -rf node_modules/ffmpeg-static && npm_config_platform=darwin npm_config_arch=arm64 npm install ffmpeg-static --no-save
scripts.publish:mac:arm64: rm -rf node_modules/ffmpeg-static && npm_config_platform=darwin npm_config_arch=arm64 npm install ffmpeg-static --no-save && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish always
scripts.publish:mac:x64: rm -rf node_modules/ffmpeg-static && npm_config_platform=darwin npm_config_arch=x64 npm install ffmpeg-static --no-save && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish always
scripts.publish:mac: npm run publish:mac:arm64 && npm run publish:mac:x64 && npm run ffmpeg:dev
scripts.publish:win: rm -rf node_modules/ffmpeg-static && npm_config_platform=win32 npm_config_arch=x64 npm install ffmpeg-static --no-save && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish always && npm run ffmpeg:dev
